_notes.purpose: DEBUG / ABLATION ONLY -- do NOT use for the final comparison unless explicitly approved.
_notes.what_it_is: Disables ML2DAC's three meta-learning components: no meta CVI selection (fixed cvi=SIL), no warmstarting (n_warmstarts=0), no algorithm/search-space reduction (limit_cs=false). This degenerates ML2DAC to plain SMAC over the full 9-algorithm config space.
_notes.important: This still requires the shipped MKR (the application phase reads evaluated_configs.csv / meta-features even when components are disabled). A TRUE no-MKR fallback is not provided because ML2DAC's ApplicationPhase cannot run without the MKR -- removing meta-learning entirely would mean running AutoML4Clust-style plain SMAC, which is a different baseline.
_notes.naming: Filename matches the requested module structure; the realistic fallback here is 'SMAC without meta-learning', not 'random'.
